text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, compose music, and even write stories. These tools are powerful because they can produce ideas quickly and in many different styles. However, AI works by learning from data created by humans, so it cannot truly feel emotions or understand what it makes. Human creativity comes from personal experience, feelings, and imagination. While AI can support artists and offer new ideas, it cannot replace the human touch. In the end, AI is a helpful tool, but real creativity still belongs to people.
